title: CompletedMatchingRingMapKernelLocalTorsion
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], m its maximal ideal, C its m-adic completion, U the complement of the closed point of Spec A, q:Y to U finite and s:E to Spec C finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and D an overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let P be the ring pushout of the matching ring and C over A, psi:P to Gamma(E) its comparison [def-sbc-completed-matching-ring-map], and i:A to P the structural map through the matching ring. For every x in P with psi(x)=0 there exist t in the natural numbers and f:Fin t to A such that m is the ideal spanned by the range of f and, for every j:Fin t, there exists e in the natural numbers with i(f(j))^e*x=0.

source.place: Tag 05ER, second paragraph (localization using 05EP and 05EQ), applied to the affine charts of Tag 0BLH

proof.text: Use Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing and Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family to choose t and f:Fin t→A with span(range f)=m. Each f(i) belongs to m by Ideal.subset_span. The resulting family can be empty; the assertion over its indices is then vacuous.

Apply the existing punctured comparison theorem to D, using hU and the finiteness of q and s, to obtain IsIso D.puncturedMap. This retains the matching-section/H0 construction through its already stated punctured comparison, rather than reconstructing the gluing module in this proof.

For each i, D(f(i)) is contained in U: a point in D(f(i)) cannot be the closed point, since f(i) belongs to m, the ideal of that point. Apply the principal-open base-change theorem, with the preceding IsIso instance, to see that Localization.awayMap of D.completedRingMap at (D.baseMap≫pushout.inl)(f(i)) is bijective.

Apply Mathlib Localization.awayMap_injective_iff to the injective part of this bijection and to x with completedRingMap(x)=0. This produces the exponent e for each i and the exact multiplication equation of the conclusion. Return the generating family with the reversed span equality; no uniform exponent or extra ideal-power argument is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05ER, second paragraph, applied to Tag 0BLH; reuse the punctured comparison and prove its principal-open completed base change in Lean, then clear denominators with Mathlib.

lean.statement:
theorem completedRingMap_kernel_local_torsion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) :
    ∀ x, D.completedRingMap x = 0 →
      ∃ (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → A),
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span (Set.range f) ∧
          ∀ i, ∃ e : ℕ,
            ((D.baseMap ≫ pushout.inl _ _).hom (f i)) ^ e * x = 0
